name: Tiki Torch-er (Big Wave Beach Endless)
notes: Columns 1 to 4 are dry ground. Columns 5 to 9 default to flooded cells without Lily Pads. For the activation, use beach_pad wherever a Lily Pad is present and beach_shore wherever the tide has left dry sand.

provenance.note: Stage and seed-bank bans checked in game version 4.2.2. The observed shoreline is between columns 4 and 5; water coverage and Lily Pads can be overridden per activation.
